nodes.label: no notebook = teach lesson
nodes.notes: If you forgot your notebook, you must teach the lesson.

nodes.label: Siri = Stupid Question
nodes.notes: If Siri goes off, Teacher C has to ask it a stupid question.

nodes.label: Yapping = Paper ball in mouth
nodes.notes: if you talk out loud or make an unfunny long joke, you have to have a paper ball in your mout the rest of the lesson

nodes.label: More hands on projects
nodes.notes: More hands on projects for the class

nodes.label: Wednesday = nap
nodes.notes: Every Wednesday we have a mandatory nap

nodes.label: Completion=Free time
nodes.notes: Completion of Meaningful assignments= 20 minutes Free Time

nodes.label: History joke = leave classroom
nodes.notes: If you make a history joke you have to leave the classroom.

nodes.label: Blurt out= hand stays up
nodes.notes: If you talk without raising your hand you have to keep your hand raised for the rest of the class period.

nodes.label: Fun seating
nodes.notes: WE SHOULD SIT WHEREVER WE WANT!!!

nodes.label: Open Note Gold Grades
nodes.notes: We are allowed to use our notes while doing a gold-grade test

nodes.label: sleep = floor
nodes.notes: If you fall asleep in class you have to lay on the floor

nodes.label: Sharpen Pencil= dance in front of class
nodes.notes: If you get up to sharpen your pencil you have to dance in front of the class.

nodes.label: Rome = 10 liveschool points
nodes.notes: anytime Teacher C says the word 'Rome' in 5th period the class gets 10 liveschool points.

nodes.label: Blurting = Presenter
nodes.notes: If you blurt out during a presentation, you have to replace the person presenting.

nodes.label: Leaning back= chair snatched
nodes.notes: If you are leaning back in your chair it gets snatched for the class period.

nodes.label: No demerits = bag of chips
nodes.notes: For the week of February 5, each student who ends the week without a demerit will get a bag of chips.

nodes.label: Yapping = silent until acknowledgement
nodes.notes: If teacher C says you were yapping during history class the week of Feb 5, for the rest of that period, you have to raise your hand and be acknowledged by a classmate or teacher c before you talk.

nodes.label: teacher's Siri = Stupid Question
nodes.notes: If Teacher C triggers Siri to wake up during history class the week of February 5, he has to ask Siri a silly question.
